coverage_audit.not_bulk_added_reason: Most candidates are closures, suspended services, buses/trolleybuses, old station locations, or already mapped under current names. No unchecked historical station import.

notes: The cited monorail really exists as an attraction; calling it fake or maglev is inaccurate. The bucket label caused confusion.
This audit does not certify every Japanese station current or complete. Four verified omissions were in raw OSM but were missed by atlas selection; independent MLIT geometry uncovered them.
Station objects are not unique station counts: OSM platforms, stop positions and station polygons may represent one public station. Additions deliberately choose one useful station object.
A series of unnamed monorails remains without enough operation evidence; retain for review rather than invent identities or delete public accessibility systems blindly.

Generic unnamed groups formerly combined disconnected lines nationally and borrowed English names from the first feature; e.g.Funicular group469 associated Mizutani industrial funicular with Mitake Cableway. Name grouping must be corrected when regenerating.
Funaoka is real public transport but currently suspended; route context should use rail_suspended and active boarding dots should be omitted.
